body: DL560 full-gate queue (agreed 2026-11-06 by both coordinators, Engram::Fable #6697): ONE shared FULL queue on DL560 for TermAl and Engram. Opus2, the TermAl integration owner, places every FULL there; each Engram FULL START needs Opus2's named slot GO. Focused jobs keep the runner census across all users. Cause: at 05:48Z an Engram FULL (test-32fcac34) started on DL560 over TermAl's running N31 FULL (test-758df116). Codex 6 stopped N31 (exit 143) under the 'never two FULLs' rule. The interruption is classified as environment/scheduling, not a test failure.
